prompt: rust repr packed struct nested repr align member restriction
answer:
Rust imposes these restrictions:

- `#[repr(align(...))]` and `#[repr(packed(...))]` cannot be applied to the same type.
- A `#[repr(packed)]` struct cannot transitively contain a type declared with `#[repr(align(...))]`, including as a nested member.
- The reverse is allowed: a `#[repr(align(...))]` struct may contain a packed struct.
- Both modifiers can be used only with the Rust or C representations.

Source: [Rust Reference — Type layout](https://doc.rust-lang.org/reference/type-layout.html)
